pvwatts_system_loss_pct.rationale: Percent system losses passed to PVWatts per shading level. 14% is the PVWatts default; 20% and 30% are product choices for some and heavy shading, not measured values.

target_offset.rationale: Share of annual usage the recommended system aims to cover. Product choice: size to roughly 90-100% of usage.

system_size_cap_kw.rationale: Upper limit on recommended system size so very large bills do not produce unrealistic rooftop systems. Product choice.

panel_degradation_per_year.rationale: Annual loss in panel output used in the 25-year projection. Product choice (0.5% per year).

analysis_years.rationale: Length of the net-savings projection. Product choice (typical panel warranty length).

ca_self_consumption_share.rationale: Share of solar output used on site (valued at the retail rate) versus exported at the lower net billing credit, for California homes. Placeholder product choices pending owner review; batteries raise self-consumption.
